# betterado_servicehook_webhook_tfs (Resource)

Manages a TFS/Azure DevOps service hook subscription that sends events to an HTTP endpoint (webhook).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "betterado_project" "example" {
  name = "ExampleProject"
}

resource "betterado_servicehook_webhook_tfs" "example" {
  project_id = data.betterado_project.example.id
  url        = "https://example.com/webhook"

  git_push {}
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project.
- `url` (String) The URL to send HTTP POST to.

### Optional

- `accept_untrusted_certs` (Boolean) Accept untrusted SSL certificates.
- `basic_auth_password` (String, Sensitive) Basic authentication password.
- `basic_auth_username` (String) Basic authentication username.
- `build_completed` (Block List) Triggers the subscription on build completion events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--build_completed))
- `detailed_messages_to_send` (String) Detailed messages to send - all, text, html, markdown or none.
- `git_pull_request_commented` (Block List) Triggers the subscription on git pull request comment events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--git_pull_request_commented))
- `git_pull_request_created` (Block List) Triggers the subscription on git pull request created events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--git_pull_request_created))
- `git_pull_request_merge_attempted` (Block List) Triggers the subscription on git pull request merge attempted events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--git_pull_request_merge_attempted))
- `git_pull_request_updated` (Block List) Triggers the subscription on git pull request updated events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--git_pull_request_updated))
- `git_push` (Block List) Triggers the subscription on git push events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--git_push))
- `http_headers` (Map of String) HTTP headers as key-value pairs.
- `messages_to_send` (String) Resource details to send - all, text, html, markdown or none.
- `repository_created` (Block List) Triggers the subscription on repository created events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--repository_created))
- `repository_deleted` (Block List) Triggers the subscription on repository deleted events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--repository_deleted))
- `repository_forked` (Block List) Triggers the subscription on repository forked events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--repository_forked))
- `repository_renamed` (Block List) Triggers the subscription on repository renamed events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--repository_renamed))
- `repository_status_changed` (Block List) Triggers the subscription on repository status changed events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--repository_status_changed))
- `resource_details_to_send` (String) Resource details to send - all, minimal, or none.
- `resource_version` (String) The resource version for the webhook subscription.
- `service_connection_created` (Block List) Triggers the subscription on service connection created events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service_connection_created))
- `service_connection_updated` (Block List) Triggers the subscription on service connection updated events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--service_connection_updated))
- `tfvc_checkin` (Block List) Triggers the subscription on TFVC check-in events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--tfvc_checkin))
- `work_item_commented` (Block List) Triggers the subscription on work item commented events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--work_item_commented))
- `work_item_created` (Block List) Triggers the subscription on work item created events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--work_item_created))
- `work_item_deleted` (Block List) Triggers the subscription on work item deleted events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--work_item_deleted))
- `work_item_restored` (Block List) Triggers the subscription on work item restored events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--work_item_restored))
- `work_item_updated` (Block List) Triggers the subscription on work item updated events. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--work_item_updated))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The subscription ID.
